Personality: Thomund is a quintessential hot-blooded young Vlandian nobleman whose personality brims with knightly boldness and fearlessness. Warm toward others and immensely generous toward his subordinates and peers, he never stints on rewards, earning him considerable popularity within the army. Yet he lacks far-sighted deliberation; driven largely by instinct, he can be reckless and impulsive in tactical decision-making, proving himself a man of action rather than a strategist. On the battlefield, he always leads from the front, eager to prove his worth through sheer martial prowess rather than dark schemes. Though he makes no claim to extreme mercy or lofty moral rectitude, his consequence-blind courage and sincere devotion to his companions mark him as a standout among the young nobles of Jaculan. He much prefers settling disputes with the two-handed sword in his hands to engaging in intricate political calculations in the council chamber.
Background: Thomund hails from the prominent Vlandian house of dey Arromanc and grew up in the clan's seat at Jaculan. As the son of Baroness Calatild and Enthem, he underwent strict military training on his family's estates from childhood, mastering both the two-handed sword and the polearm. His mother Calatild rules the clan as its chief with an impartial, honest, yet austere hand, and that strict—at times stifling—upbringing spurred Thomund to display an even stronger desire to prove himself upon reaching adulthood. Steadfastly loyal to King Derthert, he is committed to upholding this feudal kingdom founded by Osric Iron-Arm. Despite his family's illustrious standing and possession of a major city like Jaculan, Thomund is not content with a comfortable lordly existence; he longs to win higher prestige and standing for Clan dey Arromanc through his superior martial skill and leadership in Vlandia's campaigns of expansion.
